title: Permission to Retry: A Study of Authorization and Recovery in AI Agent Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2610.31916v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A durable agent can resume a consequential action while its authority changes and the action's external outcome remains uncertain. We study execution-time reliability of tool-using AI agents, isolating recovery decisions from language-model behavior. Checkpoint state, permission to dispatch, evidence of an external effect and permission to reconcile are distinct obligations. We present a finite conformance study that checks these obligations through histories scored against a provider effect ledger hidden from the recovering application. A prospectively frozen campaign executes 336 histories on native LangGraph and Temporal hosts, crossing 14 schedules, three provider contracts and four matched application policies. All 168 paired host cells have identical checked outcomes. Per host, retained-ledger reconciliation passes all 42 histories: 21 checked completions, 15 denials and six unknown outcomes with reservations retained. Cached retry

translated_title: 重试的许可：AI智能体工作流中的授权与恢复研究
translated_abstract: 持久智能体可以在其权限发生变化、且动作的外部结果仍不确定的情况下恢复一项具有重大影响的动作。我们研究使用工具的AI智能体的执行时可靠性，将恢复决策与语言模型行为隔离开来。检查点状态、分发许可、外部效果证据以及对账许可是四种彼此不同的义务。我们提出了一项有限一致性研究，通过将执行历史记录与对恢复应用隐藏的提供方效果账本进行比对评分，来检查这些义务。一项前瞻性冻结的实验在原生LangGraph和Temporal宿主上执行了336条历史记录，覆盖14种调度、三种提供方契约和四种匹配的应用策略。全部168个配对宿主单元都得到了完全相同的检查结果。在每个宿主上，保留账本对账通过了全部42条历史记录：21个已验证的完成、15个拒绝，以及6个保留预定的未知结果。缓存重试（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文将AI智能体的恢复决策与语言模型行为分离，提出一项在LangGraph和Temporal宿主上执行336条历史记录的有限一致性研究，验证了检查点状态、分发许可、外部效果证据和对账许可这四种独立义务的执行时可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a finite conformance study of authorization and recovery in AI agent workflows, isolating recovery decisions from language-model behavior and validating four distinct obligations—checkpoint state, dispatch permission, external-effect evidence, and reconciliation permission—across 336 histories executed on LangGraph and Temporal hosts with identical checked outcomes.
